soundness: A witness pair PROVES a question is not identifiable. Failing to construct one proves nothing — it may mean I did not think of the right pair. So this screen rules domains OUT and can never rule one IN. Every 'identifiable' verdict below means only 'not ruled out here'.
bias_declared: I am choosing both the domains' central questions AND the witness pairs. Two degrees of freedom, both mine. A domain could be exonerated because I picked a question it happens to handle, or condemned because I picked an unrepresentative one. This is stated because it cannot be engineered away without a practitioner from each domain, which the project does not have.
